dag.description: Non-parametric tabular lookup / set-membership model builder: Cradle load -> TabularLookupModelBuilding (the dataset itself becomes the model, either a key->values lookup map or a de-duplicated key set) -> MIMS Package/Payload -> Registration. No training and no learned parameters.

agent_context.when_to_use: Ship a non-parametric lookup as a MIMS-registered model where the dataset IS the model. Use for set-membership checks (is this normalizedAddress a known buying-club address? -> buying_club_pipeline) or key->value lookups (map an FF code to its attributes -> ffoc_pipeline) that must be served through the standard MIMS Package/Payload/Registration bookends like any ML model.
agent_context.when_not_to_use: If the decision requires a learned/parametric model (use an XGBoost/PyTorch/LightGBM DAG). If no MIMS registration is needed (a plain Cradle export suffices). If the lookup must update in real time (this builds a static model.tar.gz snapshot).
differentiators: No training step and no learned parameters: TabularLookupModelBuilding turns the dataset into model.tar.gz (a lookup map or a set_membership set)
Model producer is a Processing step, not a Training step; XGBoost/PyTorch training nodes are absent
5 nodes / 5 edges: Cradle -> lookup-build -> {Package, Payload} -> Registration

prerequisites.check: Key (and optional value) columns exist in the Cradle/EDX dataset
prerequisites.how: Cradle SQL returns key_columns (e.g. normalizedAddress) and any value_columns
dockers inference script is bundled via Package inference_scripts_input; the build step does not emit one

common_pitfalls: inference_fields must match the Registration source_model_inference_input_variable_list and the handler's request keys, NOT the build key_columns/value_columns
Package must bundle the project inference handler; the build step does not generate one
